title: Measuring Human and AI Values Based on Generative Psychometrics with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' implicit value orientations by prompting them with open-ended, value-eliciting scenarios and ethical dilemmas, then parsing their free-form responses to map them onto established psychological and cultural value systems (e.g., Schwartz's basic human values, Hofstede's VSM) using a fine-tuned evaluator model.

Comparing LLM measurement results from traditional self-report questionnaires and standardized benchmarks (like ValueBench) against the proposed generative psychometric method to detect acquiescence, positivity bias, and the tendency of models to assign artificially high scores regardless of true theoretical value structures.
